methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: energy data information model could overcome this problem and describe energy data in a uniform and semantically unambiguous way

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents requirements for a unified energy data information model (UEDIM): a semantic data-communication model for representing and transferring raw energy data (kW, kWh) across automation protocols (PROFINET, OPC UA, MQTT) up to a technical energy management system. ISO 50001 is cited only as motivating context; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or critiqued (no indicator/baseline construction, normalisation variables, or functional form). Framework without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Requirements for a unified energy data information model are presented in this paper.

stage1.notes: UEDIM is a data/semantic communication model for energy data across automation protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, PROFINET); a requirements-engineering paper. ISO 50001/EnMS is context only, with no energy performance indicator or baseline model. Not tied to any continuous-process sector.
